facts.value: Students admitted to ASU under the Western Undergraduate Exchange (WUE) program in spring 2026 or earlier will continue to receive the WUE tuition rate as long as they maintain continuous enrollment and meet the semesterly renewal requirements for WUE eligibility.
facts.programme_association: Organizational Leadership (Military and Veterans Studies) - BA

facts.value: Beginning with students admitted for fall 2026, ASU will no longer participate in the WUE program.
facts.programme_association: Organizational Leadership (Military and Veterans Studies) - BA

facts.value: Once students are admitted into an ASU WUE major, they must meet certain requirements to maintain their WUE eligibility each semester.
facts.programme_association: Organizational Leadership (Military and Veterans Studies) - BA

facts.value: Students must remain enrolled in one of the ASU WUE-eligible majors or programs.

facts.value: ASU Online programs are not eligible.
